selected_fusion_rule.name: FABRIC_OWNED_MEMBERSHIP_AT_OBSERVATION_WITNESS/v1
selected_fusion_rule.raw_node_result_rule: Keep raw model/cognition NODE_RESULT free of self-minted membership/CAS/effect authority fields.
selected_fusion_rule.fabric_wrapper_rule: The deterministic child/runtime wrapper, not model cognition, must bind the active per-node admission_id + revision + process_witness_id to the exact producer PID and exact held-S1 observation before the all-live barrier is released.
selected_fusion_rule.parent_envelope_rule: Parent may construct the final proof-carrying envelope only from the exact child barrier witness + exact raw NODE_RESULT digest; it must not substitute the then-current membership map as the observation-time identity.
selected_fusion_rule.active_batch_rule: Before a NEW cohort mutation and again under the writer lock, deterministic fabric must prove that each sealed observation-time admission/revision/process witness is still current and valid. Re-registration/rejoin before first admission => reject/recompute.
selected_fusion_rule.replay_rule: After exact cohort admission, identical replay may return the historical receipt with zero second S1 delta even if membership later changed; replay must not relabel historical admission as current.

two_phase_process_binding.reason: A process witness requires the real OS PID, but child S1 observation must occur only after that witness exists.
order: 1. Deterministically register/rejoin each logical node and obtain per-node admission_id/revision.
2. Spawn ten child OS processes into a PRE_READ_START_GATE; they must not read S1 yet.
3. Parent observes each actual PID and deterministically creates process_witness_id bound to admission_id/revision + PID.
4. Freeze relevant writers / establish the bounded cohort read window.

5. Release PRE_READ_START_GATE. Each child opens one held read-only transaction, verifies/reads its own admission+process witness through the admitted fabric read path, reads S1, produces raw NODE_RESULT, and emits the fabric-owned barrier witness.
6. Parent proves ten simultaneously live processes, exact PID/witness/packet/snapshot identity, then releases the all-live barrier.
7. Seal one canonical cohort over exact raw packet digests plus observation-time authority witnesses.
8. Revalidate all admission/revision/process witnesses under the coordinator writer transaction and commit once.

relationship_to_readset_transfer.relationship: Orthogonal but composable. Membership-at-observation binds WHO/WHICH producer realization. Fabric-observed read-set attestation binds WHAT exact admitted input/read set was delivered. Neither substitutes for the other.
relationship_to_readset_transfer.promotion_boundary: If cognition-relevant reads can bypass the observed fabric ABI, consumed-input coverage remains PARTIAL even with perfect membership/process binding.
